plain: The educated, well-read people of a society.

example.quote: Besides the freedom of our country, the great improvements she has made, and will make, in the science of government, will induce the patriots and literati of every nation to read and understand our writings on that subject ; and hence it is not improbable that she will take the lead in political knowledge.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 11, 1787 and the following sittings (Elliot prints no later date headings) (2d ed. 1836)
